title: Newness at home with experience retained

captions.energy: Opening something new without preparing transition
captions.emotions: Feeling an outdated domestic method ending

meaning: Your domestic support allows an ending when a new beginning considers present needs instead of leaving both between arrangements already cancelled and others not yet established.
text: You can create support through meaningful choice: understanding a task, comparing methods and applying experience. The Hermit in the physical position of Muladhara describes these actions. The Fool in energy complicates them through beginning without preparing conditions. Death in emotions feels that a former form has run its course and needs releasing. Inward agreement to finish can encourage starting differently too quickly. The previous method no longer feels worth maintaining, but the new one remains an appealing possibility rather than usable everyday arrangements for both.

For example, you no longer want shoes in an old closed cupboard and immediately order an open rack. Only afterwards does it become clear there is nowhere for it to stand. **Readiness to release the old does not provide conditions for the new.** You can identify space and temporary storage while preserving the change’s meaning. Experience ends an unnecessary method without making both live among shoes merely to prove that the former arrangement is genuinely behind you.

The difficulty is treating preparation as delay of necessary renewal. You hurry to begin but must restore previous solutions for basic needs. Connecting ending with continuation offers more dependable support: what leaves, what arrives and how does transition work? Thoughtfulness preserves readiness for change while making it compatible with a shared home usable now.
